findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_extract, ai_summarize, finance_sec_search, search_google_results, search_instagram_hashtag, search_tiktok_hashtag, search_web, search_youtube · Private data: crypto_dex, dex, finance_sec_events, predict_orderbook, list_endpoints, wallet_helper · Public sink: market_industry_mix, search_instagram_hashtag, search_tiktok_hashtag, x · Destructive: finance_sec_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_extract, ai_summarize, finance_sec_search, search_google_results, search_instagram_hashtag, search_tiktok_hashtag, search_web, search_youtube · Private data: crypto_dex, dex, finance_sec_events, predict_orderbook, list_endpoints, wallet_helper · Public sink: market_industry_mix, search_instagram_hashtag, search_tiktok_hashtag, x · Destructive: finance_sec_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
